name: Acorn's Delight
description:
橡果的乐趣 — adds acorns that drop from oak leaves and a jar of Acorn Jam to eat. Made to play nicely with Farmer's Delight and its add-ons.

Breaking plain oak leaves has a 13% chance to drop an Acorn. Four Acorns and two Cocoa Beans craft a bottle of Acorn Jam, which restores 4 hunger and 3.5 saturation.
